versions.changelog:
Initial release: Full-configuration backup for Alibaba Cloud WAF 3.0

- Exports complete WAF 3.0 configuration—including all onboarding types, defense rules (11 types), and template-to-resource bindings—into a single multi-sheet Excel workbook.
- Supports both Chinese mainland and International regions, merging instances under a single account.
- Auto-detects account topology: single UID or delegated administrator (multi-account unified management); member account ownership is correctly tagged and sheeted.
- Provides both human-readable parsed columns and full raw JSON for every object, enabling comprehensive configuration reconstruction.
- Includes rule-level diff capabilities against previous backups for change tracking (enabled by default).
- Operates in read-only mode, safe for audit, disaster recovery, or migration inventory use.
